newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: King Food completes due diligence on buys.
newsitem.headline: King Food completes due diligence on buys.

text.p: King Food Holdings said on Wednesday it had completed due diligence investigations on the purchase of franchised pub chains Keg and McGinty and franchised restaurant chain Saddles for an undisclosed sum of money.

The company announced last month it had agreed to buy Keg and McGinty from Keg Franchising South Africa (Pty) Ltd with effect from May 1, 1997 and acquire Saddles from Saddles Steak Franchising (Pty) Ltd with effect from March 1, this year.

On Monday this week King Food issued a cautionary that separate negotiations first announced on April 16 had been called off. Managing director Dennis Finch said this related to talks on food distribution and had no bearing on the franchise buys.
